instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

sub_questions.text: The curl of a gradient of a scalar quantity is ____.
Energy density in the magnetic field is ____.
Normal component of electric flux density is ____ across the interface between two dielectric media.
The relation of depth of penetration in good conductor is given by ____.
The direction of magnetic vector potential is same as the direction of ____.
VSWR for a matched termination is ____.
If the standing wave of voltage slopes down towards the termination, then the terminating reactance will be ____.
Quarter wave section is an ____.
Uniform plane waves are ____ waves.
Two conductors carrying current in opposite direction experience ____ force.
Derive an expression for potential due to a long pair of parallel wires.
Deduce the equation for equipotential surfaces for parallel line charges.
Find the capacitance of parallel cylindrical conductors having equal radii $a$ and separation between their axes as $b$.
Find the conductor properties and boundary conditions.

A point charge $q$ is located at a distance $h$ above an infinite conducting plane. Using the method of images, find the displacement density normal to the plane and hence surface charge density. Also obtain total charge on the infinite conducting plane.
Obtain curl of a vector and interpret it.
Prove Stokes' theorem.
Discuss ampere force law.
Obtain two Maxwell's equations which deviate from steady-state condition.

Using $\nabla \cdot \vec{D} = \rho$, Ohm's law and the equation of continuity, show that if at any instant a charge density $\rho$ existed within a conductor, it would decrease to $\frac{1}{e}$ times this value in time $\frac{\epsilon}{\sigma}$ seconds.
Discuss the propagation in a conducting medium and hence obtain the expression for attenuation constant $\alpha$ and phase-shift constant $\beta$.
Find the values of $\alpha$ and $\beta$ for good conductor and good dielectric.
Find out the reflection coefficient for perfect conductor in the case of normal incidence.
Discuss instantaneous, average and complex Poynting vectors.
Obtain power loss in a plane conductor.

A short vertical transmitting antenna erected on the surface of a perfectly conducting earth produces an effective field strength, $E_{eff} = 100 \sin \theta\text{ mV/m}$ at points a distance one mile from the antenna. Compute Poynting vector and total power radiated.
Discuss UHF line as circuit element and obtain input-input resistance of the line for resonant length.
Discuss quarter wave line as a transformer.

A lossless transmission line has a characteristic impedance of $300\ \Omega$ and is one-quarter wavelength long. What will be the voltage at the open-circuited receiving end, if sending end is connected to a generator which has a $50\text{-}\Omega$ internal impedance and generated voltage of $10\text{ volts}$?
